applicability: Chess Stories real/hypothetical/editorial transitions; future vertical or horizontal video adaptations
input_dependencies: Frozen documentary semantic event sequence with event IDs and stable state FENs
Independently verified move legality when required (no qualified oracle currently available)
Case-specific historical witness and claim admissibility status
Rights-cleared board, piece, typography and audio assets (R6 PENDING)
Measured narration and shot timings, only after lawful stimulus generation and approval

REAL_MOVE.board_rule: Use declared real state only; qualified legal replay separate
REAL_MOVE.conditional_audio: May narrate verified claim only, never rely solely on voice for real/hyp context

REWIND.board_rule: Reverse time explicitly, do not treat as played backward chess move

ENTER_HYPOTHETICAL.board_rule: Apply visible fictional label BEFORE any hypothetical piece motion

HYPOTHETICAL_MOVE.board_rule: Persistent overlay for every displayed hypothetical frame, including pauses, captions and silent viewing

RETURN_TO_REAL.board_rule: Restore correct saved real state and provenance atomically; retain hypothetical context until restoration visually complete

ELLIPSIS.board_rule: Explicit omitted interval in plies; no board tween suggesting one legal move across gap

SEQUENCE_END.board_rule: Cannot label historical game end unless independently attested; EP01 ends editorially after 25...Nxd1

safety_invariants: An overlay about factuality must be visible without audio on every frame that shows a non-historical line.
The hypothetical warning must appear before the first piece movement on the unplayed branch, not afterward.
When returning from an alternative, restore exact historical branch/state before removing alternative label; an uninterrupted fade without truth transition is insufficient.
An editorial ELLIPSIS explicitly identifies omitted real moves and start/end ply; cannot be disguised as a single move.
A source-declared chess mate is distinct from a video editorial closure; epilogue must not assert completion when the source game continues.
A source/rights validation PASS must not be inferred from subtitles, clean rendering, voice or viewer engagement.
The voice track may add explanation but may never be the only carrier of hypothetical or game-end truth.
Source screenshots, historical images or typeface files may only be used after R6 permissions and asset-level records.
No frame durations or readability thresholds have been measured or approved in this RFC.

frame_spec_proposal.frame_state_id: string referring to exact state registry entry
frame_spec_proposal.overlay_text: from fixed truthful overlay class, no unsourced historical or move-optimality claim
frame_spec_proposal.narration_claim_ids: references only documented claim registry IDs
frame_spec_proposal.captions_text: must be fact-checkable and legible muted

non_goals: Automatic fixed-duration animation derived solely from SAN
Determining historical game truth from chess legality
Copyright clearance, social publishing or approval
